Walmart's fiscal 2026 ran through January 31, 2026. I don't have its full-year capex figure, so this is an estimate of about **$6.4 billion per quarter**, from a full-year total of roughly **$25–26 billion**.

How I got there:
- Fiscal 2025 capex (payments for property and equipment) was about **$23.8 billion**.
- For fiscal 2026, management guided capex to roughly **3–3.5% of sales**, which on about $705 billion of revenue is about $21–25 billion.
- My recollection of the quarterly run-rate is about $6 billion or more per quarter. That would put the year at the top of guidance or slightly above it, around $25–26 billion.

Dividing about $25.6 billion by four quarters gives roughly **$6.4 billion**.
